content.text: {"core": "Nurturing feeds what has begun toward its own growth. In Compassion, it tends the felt bond at its opening: connection that needs supply to root. Starved of provision, it registers the bond without feeding it, so the tie is named but not stocked, and the opening thins toward mere recognition while the thing recognized goes unfed.", "sheetLine": "The bond is seen but not fed; naming stands in for nourishing."}
